      • assignCcdToInstrument

        public void assignCcdToInstrument(Ccd ccd)
        Links a CCD record to an instrument record, removing any previous link to another CCD record. The instrument is found in the PhysicalModel which is initialized when PEAS-PCS is started up to be either PCS1 or PCS2, depending on what is specified in the peas.properties file.
        Parameters:
        ccd - the new CCD record to link
